reason: I might try a free job tracker, but self-hosting plus setting up search or AI credentials sounds like extra work I can’t fit between classes. I already use my projects and coursework to apply, so I’d stick with a simple spreadsheet unless this works smoothly on my phone.
objection: Will it be genuinely easy to set up and use on my phone, without paying for hosting or providers just to see whether it helps?
would_change_my_mind: A quick phone demo showing setup takes only a few minutes and the core job search and tracking work without paid credentials.
